item.title: DPP seeking to have fatal motor vehicle crash matter involving university student Kengu Black, transferred to Home Circuit Court
item.description: The Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP) is seeking to have a fatal motor vehicle crash matter, involving university student Kengu Black, transferred from the St. Catherine Parish Court to the Home Circuit Court. The case was called up today before Acting Parish Judge Janelle Nelson Gayle. The post DPP seeking to have fatal motor vehicle crash matter involving university student Kengu Black, transferred to Home Circuit Court appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: ODPP says 10 y/o son discovered Melissa Silvera’s body
item.description: The body of Melissa Silvera, the wife of former politician Jolyan Silvera, was reportedly found in their bedroom by the couple’s 10 year old son. This was highlighted by the Director of Public Prosecutions (DPP) in a statement which outlined the reasons for acceptance of Mr. Silvera’s guilty plea for manslaughter The post ODPP says 10 y/o son discovered Melissa Silvera’s body appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: Yesterday’s shooting along Chisholm Ave left 4 including cop wounded; St Andrew South police say incident unfortunate, unnecessary
item.description: Commanding officer for the division, Senior Superintendent (SSP) Damion Manderson, told IRIE FM News that the incident occurred sometime after 6 PM. He said checks revealed that the police officer, who was attending to a domestic situation, was fired upon by armed men, who were reportedly not pleased with his presence in the area. The post Yesterday’s shooting along Chisholm Ave left 4 including cop wounded; St Andrew South police say incident unfortunate, unnecessary appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: Amendments to FID legislation passed by Upper House yesterday despite concerns from Opposition Senators
item.description: The amendment seeks to enhance the FID's operational independence and comply with international standards of the Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units, and the Financial Action Task Force (FAT-F)The Egmont Group facilitates secure international information exchange to combat money laundering, terrorism financing and associated financial crimes.
